regime_context: Detector shows Oil & Gas Producers as the clear momentum leader (score 1.675) with high durability (0.74) and full breadth (1.0) but also elevated crowding (z 1.26). Rotation is narrowing (eligible breadth 44%, absorption 0.31), Big Banks and Pipelines show trend-positive Hurst tags, and the absolute-trend gate is validated for this market, supporting a trend-aware, vol-conscious stance rather than a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (XGD.TO) as a potential challenger to the oil-led leadership: its score (1.133) is the nearest to the leader, but durability (0.42) is much lower than oil's (0.74). I would retire this watch if Gold Miners' durability bar rises above roughly 0.6 while Oil & Gas Producers' durability bar falls below roughly 0.5, signaling a confirmed handoff rather than a temporary spike. Conversely, if Oil & Gas maintains durability above 0.7 while Gold Miners stays below 0.45 for 15 more trading days, the watch retires on oil's continued dominance.
